name: pytorch-rocm-w7900
description: Pinned PyTorch/ROCm base for AMD Radeon PRO W7900 / RDNA3 / gfx1100. Installs the ROCm 10.2.0 release (core, devel, libraries, gfx1100 device wheels) and PyTorch 2.14.0+rocm10.2.0 with its gfx1100 device code and torchvision from AMD's stable wheel index (https://stable.repo.amd.com/rocm/whl-next/), then exports ABI constraints for downstream vLLM builds. The old rocm.nightlies.amd.com indexes stopped updating in 2026-06/08.
